question: Q11.01: A student runs metro = metro.geo.points_from_xy("lon", "lat"). Besides filling in the geometry column, what does this call do that building the strings by hand with pl.format("POINT ({} {})", c.lon, c.lat) does not?

options.text: It records the coordinate system in a _crs column, defaulting to EPSG:4326.
It reprojects the points into the Albers equal-area system, EPSG:5069.
It sorts the rows by longitude so the map draws from west to east.
It drops the original lon and lat columns once the points are built.
